implementation: Layer variant histories replay structural edits through a candidate model before persistence; invalid grouped operations do not replace the saved variant.
Cross-file source changes use a durable journal with per-file replacement and recovery. The implementation documents and tests recovery without claiming cross-file instantaneous atomicity.
Undo/redo validates the recorded source digests and preserves user edits made after the original transaction.
ModuleList reindexing and ModuleDict named branch ordering are represented in replayable edit history and readable project source.

Added structural operations persist a deterministic initialization_seed. Replayed add/replace/custom constructors run inside a forked CPU RNG scope, so weights remain stable without advancing the worker global RNG; legacy operations derive the same seed from the variant base seed and history position.
